source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB UID identity; cold-reset Script path is not equivalent.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x00/0x04 force UID on then off; clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and expected LED behavior.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; chassis identify; password in argv; user judges.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Automates command but lacks safe credentials, bounded duration and objective physical observation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires confirmation, verified rack identity, interval/force validation, observer and restore.
historical_reviews.history: No approved mapping makes the unrelated cold-reset Script authoritative.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Physical indicator evidence remains manual/package assisted.

original_test_intent: Toggle the selected chassis UID indicator on and off and verify the correct physical chassis responds.
original_method: Send 0x00/0x04 identify requests and observe the physical UID LED.
manual_activity: Owner verifies rack/chassis identity and approves a human or camera observation window.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level identify is partial and its password handling is unsafe; physical target proof remains required.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x00/0x04 with validated duration/force and an independent physical observer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source on/off bytes, Script and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture UID baseline, identify the exact chassis for a bounded period, observe it physically, then restore off/baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target proof, bounded timing and restore evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion alone cannot prove the intended chassis LED changed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target identification may cause service on the wrong system.

project_override_considerations: A vendor LED API is equivalent only with the same verified chassis, on/off behavior, bounded duration and physical evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and raw command agree; Script path is unrelated but does not obscure the explicit primary procedure.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Command purpose is clear; observer and target data are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong-chassis acceptance and requires objective LED restoration evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: UID is a physical-location function: transport success proves only BMC acceptance, not which lamp illuminated. The oracle must bind BMC identity to rack location and confirm both on and off states within a bounded interval.
